parts.answer: Shade the intersection outside or on the circle $|z|=2$ and inside or on the circle centred at $1-i$ with radius $1$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Show a circle with centre the origin and radius $2$ — B1.

Show the point representing $1-i$ — B1.

Show a circle with centre $1-i$ and radius $1$ — B1 FT, following through on the position of $1-i$.

Shade the appropriate region — B1 FT, following through on the position of $1-i$: outside the circle centred at the origin with radius $2$, and inside the circle centred at $1-i$ with radius $1$. The official guidance also accepts follow-through shading for a circle centred at $\pm1\pm i$ according to the plotted point.

Total [4].
